records.element: Scene plate — fire circle (L1, L7 second half)
records.choice: Generated wide shot: blank-oval figures in rust tunics around one fire on the golden plain at dusk.
records.alternatives: None recorded — first take matched the locked world anchors (Ep.1 dialect) on inspection.
records.context: Format v3 world anchors (golden plain, cream oval heads, rust tunics); the circle IS the mechanism — an audience that copies by hearing.
records.why: The episode's claim (a story reaches everyone) is visible in one frame: many listeners, one fire.
records.change: If Studio retention dips at 0–5 s, the opening image is the first suspect.

records.choice: One standing figure, arms raised mid-telling, seated listeners turned toward him.
records.alternatives: None recorded.
records.context: N-03: the concrete example (the river that runs when others dry) needs a teller performing it.
records.why: Telling is shown as an act, not described — the raised arms read as emphatic telling with the label.
records.change: A viewer comment misreading the gesture reopens it.

records.choice: Tighter circle, every head turned to the teller.
records.alternatives: Reusing the wide fire plate for L4–L5.
records.context: L4–L5 state the mechanism (copying by hearing); the intent log calls for attention made visible.
records.why: A closer frame at the mechanism beat: hearing = copying is drawn as turned heads.
records.change: If the two fire plates read as the same shot in retention comments, differentiate further.

records.choice: Grey elder + two young figures passing the story on, same fire grammar.
records.alternatives: None recorded.
records.context: L6's job: retelling across generations; the teller dies, the knowledge lives.
records.why: Age contrast inside one frame carries 'children retell it, and theirs' without a word of caption.

records.alternatives: A new 'few watchers' scene drawn for Ep.2.
records.context: Series Chekhov: Ep.1's behavioural channel is the plant L7 pays off ('a body passed knowledge to a few').
records.why: Reusing Ep.1's exact frame performs the contrast (few watchers → everyone listening) instead of describing it — the strongest device in the episode.
records.change: If Ep.1's frame is ever rebuilt, this plate follows it.

records.choice: Low embers, bowed heads, deep-blue night.
records.alternatives: None recorded.
records.context: N-06: the villain (Forgetting) gets a face — a fire going out; N-07's sting beat.
records.why: The only dark plate in the episode lands exactly on the turn; mood does the arguing.

records.element: Visual flow — plate motion + scene joins (v4 improvement round)
records.choice: Plate-local continuous zoom: each plate's push-in (0.6 %/s, cap +7.5 %) accumulates across all of its lines and pauses on a plate-local clock and resumes if the plate returns (firewide at L7). Plate changes are 0.4 s dissolves (incoming fades in over the held outgoing plate), EXCEPT the L7 water->fire transformation, which stays a cut by design.
records.alternatives: v3 behaviour: zoom computed per line (1->1.055 within each line, snapping back at every line boundary — 11 resets in 54 s, five on an unchanged plate) and hard cuts at every plate change. Also considered: dissolves everywhere including L7 (rejected — it would soften the one transformation that performs the claim).
records.context: STRUCT-2 H-S7 (visual-story flow) was Ep.2 v3's single WEAK class; Hadi's #19 verdict scored v3 at 70 ('the floor'). Written grammar: dissolve = time passing inside the story's world; cut = the world itself changing (few watchers -> everyone listening).
records.why: The eye is carried across beats instead of parked and re-started; the one remaining cut now means something specific instead of being the default.
records.change: Hadi's judgment on v4 (#19 stays open for it) or Studio retention evidence against a specific join reopens that join's record.

records.choice: Every label carries explicit on/off times (derived from the v3 progress thresholds) with fade ramps (0.30 s in / 0.25 s out; shorter for the two punch labels).
records.alternatives: v3 behaviour: opacity toggled instantly at thresholds — 10 visible snaps across the piece.
records.context: Same H-S7 flow repair as DR-GAP-FLOW: text that blinks fights the carried eye the flow fix builds.
records.why: Labels now breathe in and out at the same tempo as the plates dissolve.
records.change: A label reading as late/early against its spoken beat reopens its times here.

records.choice: The card fades OUT over 1.15-1.65 s, on top of the already-live first scene (same firewide plate beneath), instead of sitting opaque and snapping off at 1.6 s.
records.alternatives: v3 behaviour (opaque hold, hard off). Cold-open with no card — DR-CARD-1's recorded open format question; not taken silently here.
records.context: Retention: the first ~2 s are container before story; the snap at 1.6 s was the roughest single frame transition in v3. The container itself is Hadi-approved format (Ep.1 i7).
records.why: The eye settles onto the scene as the narration starts; the hook's first words land on an already-moving picture.
records.change: When Hadi settles the container-vs-hook question (DR-CARD-1), this exit is revisited with it.

records.element: Word pops — PROPOSAL for Action #36, built for judgment on the artifact (v4)
records.choice: Rule: one pop per phrase; the sentence-final concept word wins. 22 pops -> 20. Demoted to ordinary words: 'knowledge' (L1 — shares its phrase with 'stories.', the medium the episode is about) and 'water' (L2 — 'river' already carries the concrete case). All other pops survive the audit: cargo (stories), mechanism (copied, copies, heard), constraint (written), villain (forgetting, fades), thesis (backup), contrast pairs (dies/lives, few/everyone), archives (body, story), one->many (many), no-original (original).
records.alternatives: Keep all 22 (every popped word is individually defensible — the failure is density in two phrases, not word choice). Demote further to a fixed quota (rejected — quota is a number, not a principle).
records.context: Action #36 (which words grow and glow) is undecided; under the score-triggered improvement rule (Hadi, 2026-10-24) rule-asks on a scored piece convert to Archer's best proposal built into the new version, judged as an artifact.
records.why: A pop is a signal; two pops in one phrase halve each other. One per phrase keeps every pop load-bearing.
records.change: Hadi ratifies, restores a demoted word, or sets a different rule on the v4 artifact — the demotions are two flags in the PLAN data and revert in one edit.

records.element: Word entrance motion — PROPOSAL for Action #37, built for judgment (v4)
records.choice: Keep easeOut-cubic arrival; lengthen 0.16 s -> 0.20 s; add a 12 px rise (translateY +12 -> 0) so each word travels a short upward path into its slot. Key-word overshoot pulse unchanged.
records.alternatives: Smoothstep entrances (the other candidate in #37): rejected as the proposal because its slow start holds words small and faint longer, hurting glance-reading at feed speed. v3's in-place blink-scale (no travel at all).
records.context: Action #37 (motion feel) is undecided and lists as an ownership candidate in #51; score-triggered rule: Archer's best proposal ships in the artifact for judgment.
records.why: Motion with a direction gives the eye a route to follow (flow, H-S7); arrival speed serves readability — the word is near-full-size within ~3 frames.
records.change: Hadi's pick on the artifact (this proposal vs smoothstep) settles #37; the curve is one function in the engine.

records.choice: Pauses stay exactly as recorded in the locked mix — measured inter-line gaps 0.40-0.60 s, patterned: the longest precede the turns (0.60 s before L8 'But...', 0.60 s before the L11 bookend, 0.50 s before L10 'So say it plainly'). What changes is the picture inside them: DR-GAP-FLOW's continuous drift replaces v3's frozen full-zoom stills, so a pause reads as the camera breathing, not a stall.
records.alternatives: Tighten the gaps (impossible without re-voicing — the pauses live in the locked narration). Fill pauses with new visual events (rejected — noise over a deliberate breath).
records.context: Action #38 asks whether the flagship should adopt Earth One's breathing pauses. For this piece the question is answered by measurement: Ep.2's pauses are deliberate at its hinges, not random.
records.why: A breath only reads as a breath if the picture stays alive inside it.
records.change: The cloned-voice pass may re-time pauses deliberately; until then the mix is locked.

records.element: End-card hold — PROPOSAL for Action #42, built (= unchanged) for judgment (v4)
records.choice: Hold stays 3.4 s. Proposed rule: hold time follows card text load (~0.55 s per text line + 0.4 s settle, minimum 1.6 s). This card carries 6 lines (follow ask x2, NEXT tease x3, channel bug) and a 0.6 s fade-in, so ~3.0 s of its hold is reading time.
records.alternatives: Flagship parity at 1.6 s: rejected — the NEXT episode's title (the retention device that sells Ep.3) would be unreadable at a glance.
records.context: Action #42 (one end-card hold or two) is undecided; Earth One's card is text-heavy BY DESIGN (N-09: the ask and the tease are stated plainly), the flagship's is not — two holds, one principle.
records.why: The hold is not dead time; it is the reading time of the piece's onward route.
records.change: Hadi's ruling on #42; if he sets one doctrine, the rule above is the proposed form of it.

records.element: SFX / ambience layer — PROPOSAL for Action #39, DECIDED but NOT BUILT in v4 (flagged)
records.choice: Proposal: YES — a fire-world ambience layer. Soft fire crackle under the L1-L7 fire scenes (~-26 dB under the bed), thinning to sparse ticks across L8-L10 as the fire dies (the villain, Forgetting, becomes audible), near-silence at 'no original to check', first faint dawn birds under L11-L12. NOT built into v4.
records.alternatives: Build it into v4 now (rejected — see why). No SFX ever (voice + bed only — the current state, and #39's other side).
records.context: Action #39 (should a fire sound like a fire) is undecided and SFX existence is one of the five ownership candidates in Action #51. The template's audio pattern was set at Ep.1 i7 approval, and Hadi's 70 on v3 was scored hearing this mix.
records.why: Not built because: (1) it changes the approved audio mix under a scored template; (2) SFX existence is an owner-domain decision — building it into the template would settle a lane question by fait accompli; (3) it does not need to ride v4 — the stems exist (hidden_files/earthone-ep02/voice.wav + bed.wav), so Hadi's yes is a mix-only build order: narration stem identical, no re-voice, A-11 chain re-run and re-measured.
records.change: Hadi's ruling on #39 executes this spec as a v4.1 audio pass.

records.element: Visual storytelling events — plate mood + word fade (v4, doctrine pass 2026-10-24 ~17:35 ET)
records.choice: Line-scoped visual events so the picture performs the beat (visual-storytelling doctrine: word animation is a storytelling engine; sound-off the story must read from pictures + animated words). (1) L6 generations plate: brightness dips 16 % through the line's middle — the hunter dies — and recovers as his knowledge lives. (2) L8-L10 embers plate: dims 22 % across L8-L9 (forgetting wins), rekindles across L10 to +2 % at 'hard to kill'. (3) L9's words fade to ~45 % inside each phrase as it plays — 'it fades in every head at once' enacted; L10's words return at full strength against it. (4) L11-CEND finale plate: +5 % dawn lift. Keyed strictly to generations/embers/finale plates and L9 words, so the already-rendered opening/L1-L5 segments (firewide/hunter/listen plates, mood 1.0) are byte-consistent with the rest.
records.alternatives: New generated plates per beat (rejected — v4 builds from v3's scene per brief; plate generation is the Ep.3-style rebuild lane). Leaving L8-L10 on one static embers plate for ~13 s (the pre-doctrine state — three beats, no visual event, the piece's weakest sound-off stretch).
records.context: Hadi's visual-storytelling + exemplar doctrine landed mid-build (2026-10-24 ~17:35 ET): visuals are 'lazy and minimal'; every beat must carry a visual event; applied to what was still open in this build (segments line-06..endcard unrendered at that moment) without restarting finished work.
records.why: Sound-off, the forgetting arc is the story's villain beat; before this record it looked identical to the beats around it. The mood arc makes the villain visible and the backup's arrival a rekindling.
records.change: Judged by Hadi on the artifact with the rest of v4 (Action #19 sitting); values are three numbers in one engine function (plateMood) if he wants them stronger or weaker.

records.element: Word choreography L6-L11 + pride fixes — DECIDED per word (word-choreography + pride doctrine, 2026-10-24 ~17:43 ET)
records.choice: Per-word decisions (all in the engine's choreo block, applied to the still-open lines L6-L12; L1-L5 were already rendered and keep the GAP-MOTION/POPS grammar — recorded inconsistency, accepted over restarting finished work): L6 'dies;' shrinks to 0.80x, sinks 8 px, dims to 70 % — 'lives.' grows 1.18x and lifts — death and survival are performed by the words. L7 'few.' at 0.78x vs 'everyone.' at 1.22x — the audience size change happens IN word size across the L7 cut. L8 'forgetting.' flickers (opacity 0.75+0.25*sin(30t)) — the enemy intrudes unstably. L9 every word fades to 45 % AND shrinks 18 % inside its phrase (fading = disappearing, DR-GAP-VISUAL extended); L10 'hard to kill.' words deliberately hold full size/opacity against it (decided restraint = resistance), 'One' 0.90x vs 'many,' 1.25x — one becomes many in size. L11 'body.' 0.92x vs 'story' 1.15x — the second archive outweighs the first. L12: NO embellishment, decided restraint — it is the flagged banned-formula line (DR-GAP / GAP-10); its words enter uniformly and are not dressed. PRIDE FIXES applied under the same record: (1) L12's two remaining pops (the subscribe / follow words) DEMOTED to ordinary words (key false, 118->100, rust->dark ink) — under DR-GAP-POPS' own rule pops are for concept words, and the banned CTA must not carry the piece's biggest emphasis; total pops 20 -> 18. (2) Channel bug switches to dark ink (#2b2018) on the pale water and finale plates where the cream bug was near-invisible in v3 frames (t=24.0, 42.0); those plates appear only in open segments, so no rendered segment changes.
records.alternatives: Uniform entrance everywhere (the pre-doctrine state — undecided word behaviour = randomness under the choreography doctrine). Re-rendering L1-L5 with matching choreography (rejected — finished work is not restarted; the grammar is shared, only the per-word events are line-scoped). Choreographing L12's CTA words for flair (rejected — polishing a banned formula).
records.context: Hadi's word-choreography + pride doctrine landed mid-build (2026-10-24 ~17:43 ET): words must TELL the story; which words shrink/grow/flip is actively decided per beat and recorded; any visible flaw gets fixed now, not passed up.
records.why: Sound-off, a muted viewer now sees quantity, death, fading and survival happen to the words themselves in L6-L11 — the beats where v3's words merely appeared.
records.change: Judged by Hadi on the artifact (Action #19 sitting); every value is one line in the engine's choreo block or one PLAN flag if he wants any word's behaviour changed.

records.element: Word-decision container — all 139 display words (doctrine pass, 2026-10-24 ~17:47 ET)
records.choice: Every word in the piece carries a recorded decision in the word_decisions array of this decisions block: 9 choreographed treatments (DR-GAP-CHOREO), 10 key pops (DR-GAP-POPS, 2 of them in L9, where they then join the fade), L9's line-wide fade+shrink (15 words in total), L10's decided hold (3 words), L12's decided restraint (13 words), and deliberate as-is for the remaining 91 — each with its story function, measured tempo (from the locked word timings) and the reason no individual event was assigned (the beat's decided event is named in every as-is entry). Coverage 139/139, counted, not asserted.
records.alternatives: Leaving ordinary words at engine default with no record (the pre-doctrine state — undecided word behaviour, which the word-decision-container doctrine names randomness even when it looks fine).
records.context: Hadi's word-decision-container refinement (2026-10-24 ~17:47 ET) of the choreography doctrine: decisions live in the video's production context (this scene file); a deliberate 'use it as is' is itself an active decision and must be recorded with its reasons.
records.why: Future builds of this template inherit per-word intent instead of re-deriving or accidentally losing it; the count makes the coverage auditable in QC.
records.change: Any word's treatment can be flipped by editing its entry + the engine's choreo block; the QC script counts the container.

build_records.element: Engine boundary sync — the C-06 repair (decided, with evidence)
build_records.choice: The EO scene engines rendered only the FIRST phrase whose window contains t (a first-match break), so under C-05(a) carry-over phrase ends a held phrase suppressed the incoming phrase's words for up to ~0.8 s past their spoken starts. The loop was removed in all 9 EO build sources — every phrase whose window contains t now renders (fastlane semantics; bands alternate; z-order by phrase start) — and Ep.2 v4 was re-rendered through the fixed engine: only the 55 carry-over phrase ends + the engine changed; starts, prose and audio byte-invariant.
build_records.alternatives: Shipping the JOB B29 plan rebuild on plan-level measurements alone — refused: its plan passed every invariant (dwell violations 44→1) while the render broke word-sync; the build was stopped and the delivered files restored byte-identical.
build_records.context: QC C-06 BOUNDARY SYNC (files/qc-checklist.md line 144; added v2.18 by this job). Verification on the delivered file, both legs: DOM boundary-sync probe 56 boundaries / 55 overlaps / 0 failures; delivered-file pixel proof 56/55/0. Negative control: with the break re-inserted into a copy of the scene, the same DOM probe reports 119 failures vs 0 on the repaired scene — the control is DOM-level, not a delivered pre/post still pair (precision set by Dot, video-verification-lab n=11, adopted).
build_records.why: Word-sync is a delivered-file property, not a plan property: a held phrase must never hide the next phrase's spoken words (verify on the layer the claim is about).
build_records.change: Any future engine edit re-runs the C-06 probe + delivered-file pixel proof before the build ships.
